sources.title: Attorney General’s Chambers, Revised Laws of Saint Lucia (2023), Bank Holidays Act, Schedule
sources.said: BANK HOLIDAYS 1 January 2 January 22 February which shall be known and referred to as Saint Lucia Independence Day Good Friday Easter Monday Whit Monday 1 May which shall be known as Labour Day Corpus Christi 1 August, which shall be known as Emancipation Day Thanksgiving Day 13 December which shall be referred to as Saint Lucia Day Christmas Day 26 December All days which the Governor General may by Proclamation, declare and appoint to be days of solemn fasts or days of thanksgiving or public holidays. Note: If any of the above days fall on a Sunday, or bank holiday, the Monday, or other day, immediately next following not being a holiday is a bank holiday, unless some other day is appointed for the purpose. (Amended by Acts 7 of 1958, 3 of 1964, 15 of 1964, 6 of 1966, 19 of 1984, 20 of 2000 and 5 of 2004)

sources.title: Bank of Saint Lucia, Holiday Closure Notice - Thanksgiving (2025): the day Thanksgiving is kept
sources.said: ALL BANK BRANCHES … will be CLOSED on Monday, October 6, 2025 in observance of Thanksgiving Day. All locations will reopen for business on Tuesday, October 7, 2025.

sources.title: National Printing Corporation, Saint Lucia Gazette 2026 (the weekly issues of November 2025 to August 2026, each read)
sources.said: No proclamation appointing or substituting a bank or public holiday appears in the issues of 10 November 2025 to 17 August 2026; their mentions of public holidays are office hours (“except public holidays”).
